message:
test(ka-pc): each WebView a ka-pc e2e can bring up gets its own UDF -- the macro's too (Codex test SOURCE r1 N1, r2 addition)

The macro window (client_macro_window.cpp, GetTempPathW + GNLinkMacro) lives in a viewer, and every viewer inherits the
test's environment: with the shell's WEBVIEW2_USER_DATA_FOLDER in it, a macro WebView would have shared the shell's folder.
Now the preflight (shared: ka_pc_e2e_webview.hpp) holds for both names. The shell e2e sets the shell's UDF until its
environment is confirmed by get_UserDataFolder, then the macro's for every viewer started after it (before the sign-in);
a re-creation of the shell's WebView (WM_APP + 3) is not dispatched and stops the run. The managed e2e sets the macro's
UDF for all its children. A macro window of a process of this build fails the run (its folder cannot be confirmed from
the test), and the run's macro UDF must not exist at the end. ka_pc_e2e_child_test runs the preflight and its refusals
without any WebView. No product profile default changed.

Product files unchanged against cd9937a; the shared guard unchanged. No e2e was run.
